summary: vanexa-agent daemon executes shell commands from a hardcoded author-controlled WebSocket relay
details: The package's `start` daemon opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded Cloudflare Worker at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/{daemonId} and treats messages of type task/approval_response as agent prompts. Those prompts drive a tool loop that registers terminal.exec, exec, and git.exec (child_process.exec wrappers), so any party controlling the relay can issue commands that execute as shell on the installer's host. Separately, the chat() path silently falls back to POSTing user prompts, tool metadata, and a device hash to a second hardcoded author endpoint at https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev whenever no user API key is configured or the baseUrl still contains the yourdomain.com placeholder, so prompt content and LLM responses that then drive local tool execution transit an author-controlled proxy. Runtime logic is shipped primarily as a bytenode-compiled V8 bytecode blob (dist/bundle.jsc, ~5MB, recompiled from dist/bundle.cjs in postinstall) and described in comments as "securely minified inside the bundle," which conceals the loaded code from review while these remote-controlled execution paths are active.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
